answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 35060 Country: India Title: I am registered pharmacist according to Maharashtra pharmacy council Question: I am registered pharmacist according to Maharashtra pharmacy council. I have a license to open medical shop. Can I give this license on rent basis (some fixed monthly amount) to other person to open the medical shop? Answer ID: 35060 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1767/1242/L=1432) If the government gives the licence to the specific person and he is not allowed to give it to any other person, then it shall be lie and deception to give such licence to a person on rent and hence it will be unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
